about_the_game:
Shadow of the Rift: A Continent's Peace is Shattered

The land of Veridia, blessed with abundant life and rich resources, has known peace for generations. But that peace is shattered. From another dimension, a malevolent entity appears, tearing open dimensional rifts across the continent. From these rifts, it summons hordes of monsters, their minds and bodies twisted and corrupted by its vile magic. In an instant, Veridia is plunged into chaos and destruction.

In the midst of this turmoil, an ordinary young man from a small village, living a simple life of farming and hunting, awakens a dormant power within. To save Veridia and protect his home, he must take up the sword and accept his new destiny: to stand against this dark force and its legion.

Join the journey to restore peace to the continent of Veridia!

Three Classes to Choose From

You can pick one of three classes, each with its own special traits. As you go on adventures, you’ll level up and improve your character's unique skills.

 

Weapon and Skill System

Pick the right weapons for your class and set up the skills that match your playstyle. The more you use a weapon or a skill, the stronger it becomes, giving you better stats and improved effects.

 

Leveling and Upgrades

Hunt monsters to gain levels, and choose which stats to increase as your character grows. You can also upgrade your weapons and armor to make your character much stronger.

 

Item Crafting

Besides the items you get from monsters, you can find different materials in the world. Use them to craft special, rare items to make your character stand out.

 

Take Over Rifts and Expand Your Area

Enemies will appear from things called "Dimensional Rifts." You can fight to capture these rifts and expand the area you control. Once you capture a rift, you can use it to fast travel around the world.

 

Grow and Get Stronger

Your goal is to take over enemy land to make your territory bigger, and you’ll also need to defend your areas from enemy attacks.

short_description: For centuries, Veridia thrived. Now, an otherworldly invader tears rifts, unleashing maddened beasts. In the chaos, you awaken—once a humble farmer and hunter. Take up the sword, wield your power, and save Veridia.
